'''Karagga's Palace''' was the residence of [[Karagga]], whose size and majesty were impressive. Here lived the personal [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] of Karagga, [[Bonethrasher]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
